title: Mclader Joins Cognition to Lead Industries After Selling USDH to Coinbase

tickers.name: Coinbase Global, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The former lead of Native Markets is now recruiting entrepreneurs and product operators to help AI startup Cognition scale its software tools across various commercial sectors. Mclader has joined the company as the Head of Industries to oversee this expansion after selling the USDH asset of Native Markets to Coinbase.

He is targeting founders with a track record of shipping real-world products to join his team. Mclader cited a long-term professional relationship with Cognition co-founder Scott Wu and a belief in the capabilities of the company's AI software engineer, Devin, as his primary motivations for joining the firm.

Update: I am joining the @cognition team as the new Head of Industries, after selling Native Markets’ USDH to Coinbase. 

I've known @ScottWu46 since he was a beta tester of Uniswap products and have been bullish on Devin since the first demo. I couldn’t be more excited to drive this next step.

I am hiring entrepreneurs who've been building on hard mode to join a team that will transform how every vertical builds software.

If you’re a founder or operator who has shipped and sold products in the real world, and you have a vision for what’s now possible in your industry with AI, shoot me a DM. I’d love to chat.
